name: Our Lady of Guadalupe School v. Morrissey-Berru
summary: The Supreme Court held that the ministerial exception applies to Catholic school teachers who played a significant role in religious instruction and mission, even though they lacked the title of 'minister.'
significance: The Court expanded the ministerial exception beyond formally ordained clergy to include lay teachers who performed religious duties, strengthening the Missionaries' argument that their employee falls within constitutionally protected employment relationships.
